source_documents.title: AIE-active Schiff base compounds as fluorescent probes for highly sensitive and selective detection of Fe3+ ions

reference_evidence_units.quote: Lesser fluorescence intensity for L1 and L2 in THF medium is due to the intramolecular C=N isomerization.
reference_evidence_units.subject: L1, L2
reference_evidence_units.statement: C=N isomerization quenches emission in solution.

reference_evidence_units.quote: With the increase in water content, the C=N isomerization are gradually arrested through intramolecular hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.subject: L1, L2

reference_evidence_units.quote: The fluorescence turn-off response of L1/L2 with Fe3+ could be attributed to PET inhibition mechanism
reference_evidence_units.subject: L1/L2-Fe3+ complexes

reference_evidence_units.quote: the Ф values for L2 increased from 0.017 to 0.136
reference_evidence_units.subject: L2

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: L2: AIE from arresting C=N isomerization (an intramolecular torsion) in aggregates.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: L2: AIE from arresting C=N isomerization (an intramolecular torsion) in aggregates.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The o-hydroxy Schiff base could in principle undergo ESIPT, but the paper does not discuss it.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: PET/LMCT concerns the Fe3+ complex (guideline §3.4); recorded out of pool.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: kr/knr changes are reported for Fe3+ binding, i.e. for the complex; not labelled on the free ligand.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

out_of_pool: Fe3+ binding quenches by PET/LMCT and changes kr/knr (complex; E03)

contrast_group.varied_factor: methyl on the salicylidene ring (L1: H, L2: 5-CH3)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Same AIE explanation; L2 peaks at lower water fraction (60% vs 90%).
